mission: Reduce measured complete FFN and whole-generation cost while preserving full four-step Wan I2V video quality; no assumed mask, sparse operator, compensation or dense completion.

questions.name: What useful information exists?
questions.focus: Local-activation predictability vs finite downstream action-value information under residual bypass.

questions.name: Can available information pay for itself?
questions.focus: Conditional decision regret/NetVOI after readout, caching, router and actual operator costs versus strongest fixed same-cost control.

questions.name: Which actual FFN work may be omitted?
questions.focus: Causal whole-action effect through quantization, residual/attention, blocks, free four-step video and complete native latency.

default_research_loop: Discover useful mechanism from either information, operator structure, video artifact or recent science
Apply PRD exact/conditional rewrite, mechanism taxonomy or task reduction when it unlocks a new representation
Ground decision-critical claims in true Wan source/QDQ/residual/step semantics and saved evidence
Differentiate competing explanations with a meaningful mathematical proof, artifact or approved targeted observation
Develop constructive next action, compare closest prior mechanisms and record exact scope
